steps: Type `Ada Lovelace` into the "Customer name" field.
Type `ada@example.com` into "E-mail address".
Click the "Medium" radio under Pizza Size and tick the "Bacon" checkbox.
Type `ring twice` into the "Delivery instructions" textarea.
Click the "Submit order" button.
ev-httpbin-pizza-form.check: The browser lands on https://httpbin.org/post and the JSON body contains "custname": "Ada Lovelace", "size": "medium" and "topping": "bacon".

steps: Type `quantum computing` into the first "Search term..." field.
Choose "Title" in the field dropdown beside it.
Tick the "Computer Science (cs)" subject checkbox.
Leave "Date: All dates" selected and click the "Search" button.
ev-arxiv-advanced-search.check: The results URL contains terms-0-field=title and classification-computer_science=y, and the page shows a results header of the form "Showing 1-50 of N results".

steps: Type `Edinburgh` into the table's "Search:" box.
Click the "Age" column header to sort ascending.
Change the "Show [10] entries" dropdown to 25.
Clear the search box.
ev-datatables-zero-config.check: After step 1 the table body holds exactly 9 rows, every one with Office = "Edinburgh", and the info line reads "Showing 1 to 9 of 9 entries (filtered from 57 total entries)".

steps: Type `write the eval` into the "What needs to be done?" input and press Enter.
Type `ship it` into the same input and press Enter.
Click the round toggle checkbox on the first todo to mark it done.
Click the "Completed" link in the footer filter bar.
ev-todomvc-react.check: The URL becomes .../#/completed with no full page load, exactly 1 todo row is visible ("write the eval"), and the footer counter reads "1 item left".

steps: Click the search field in the header (placeholder/aria-label `Wikipedia内を検索`).
Type `東京タワー`.
Press Enter (or click the 検索 button) to go to the article.
On the article, click the 履歴表示 tab in the tab strip.
ev-jawiki-tokyo-tower.check: The URL is https://ja.wikipedia.org/w/index.php?title=東京タワー&action=history and the document title is 「東京タワー」の変更履歴 - Wikipedia.

steps: Scroll to the "Live demo" section.
Click the "Launch demo modal" button.
Read the dialog body.
Click the "Close" button in the modal footer.
ev-bootstrap-modal-demo.check: After step 2 a dialog is on screen titled "Modal title" whose body reads "Woo-hoo, you're reading this text in a modal!", with footer buttons "Close" and "Save changes". After step 4 it is gone.

steps: Click the combobox labelled "Favorite Fruit", which initially reads "Choose a Fruit".
Click the option "Durian" in the listbox that opens.
Click the combobox again to reopen it.
Type `g` to jump to "Grape", then press Enter.
ev-apg-select-only-combobox.check: The combobox displays the text "Grape", its aria-expanded is back to "false", and the Grape option carries aria-selected="true".

steps: In the sidebar "Table of Contents", click the entry "The range() Function".
Click the entry "match Statements" in the same TOC.
Click "Defining Functions".
Type `enumerate` into the "Quick search" box in the top nav bar and click "Go".
ev-python-docs-controlflow.check: The browser lands on https://docs.python.org/3/search.html?q=enumerate and the #search-results panel fills with hits.
